ctaBand.title: Ready to modernize your school?
ctaBand.subtitle: Create your school in 3 minutes or install the desktop app for the office.

offline.a: Yes. The installed Windows version at the office works fully offline. Browser and phone require a connection.

data.a: On the school PC (Documents/SchoolManager) and, when cloud sync is enabled, a secure copy for web and mobile access.

install.q: Do you need to visit for installation?
install.a: No. Download the installer, run it, sign in with the same account as on the web. Our support can guide you remotely.

migrate.q: Can I migrate from another system?
migrate.a: Yes — CSV student import and assisted migration for lists and balances on request.

sections.q: Does it support francophone, anglophone and nursery?
sections.a: Yes — Cameroon levels, multiple sections and nursery classes are supported natively.

support.a: WhatsApp support Mon–Sat, remote installation help and migration assistance on Standard and Premium plans.
